rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site aggregated dataset; 123,984 MRI scans across more than 100 primary studies.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "we aggregated 123,984 MRI scans, across more than 100 primary studies, from 101,457 human participants"

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference dataset includes established public datasets such as UK Biobank, ABCD, HCP, HBN, AIBL, ADNI, INDI (FCON), Cam-CAN, and ENIGMA.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "We acknowledge the invaluable contribution to this effort made by several openly shared MRI datasets: OpenNeuro (https://openneuro.org/), the Healthy Brain Network (https:// healthybrainnetwork.org/), UK BioBank (https://www.ukbiobank.ac.uk/), ABCD (https:// abcdstudy.org/), ... the Human Connectome Project (http://www.humanconnectomeproject.org/), ... the International Neuroimaging Datasharing Initiative (INDI) (https://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/) ... Data used in the preparation of this article was obtained from the Australian Imaging Biomarkers and Lifestyle flagship study of ageing (AIBL) ... Data used in preparation of this article were obtained from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) ... Further information about the Cam-CAN corporate authorship membership ... Details of The ENIGMA Developmental Brain Age working group..."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; totals computed by summing study-level sample sizes per phenotype from Supplementary Table 1.2-1.8 (Table1_Demographics CSVs).
rci5_n.supporting_text: "SI1.2–SI1.42, demographic information per study and sex for each individual brain imaging phenotype (that is, SI1.2 has demographics for all control subjects included in the GMV model, SI1.3 for all subjects included in the WMV model, etc.)."

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; sex totals computed by summing study-level female/male sample sizes per phenotype from Supplementary Table 1.2-1.8 (Table1_Demographics CSVs).
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "SI1.2–SI1.42, demographic information per study and sex for each individual brain imaging phenotype (that is, SI1.2 has demographics for all control subjects included in the GMV model, SI1.3 for all subjects included in the WMV model, etc.)."

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; weighted mean ages computed from study-level mean ages and sample sizes per phenotype; min/max from study-level minimum/maximum ages. Age in years (days/365.25).
